LEARNING UNDER THE NIGHT SKY:
STUDENT EXPERIENCES OF CAMPUS STUDY SPACES

A thesis submitted in partial fulfillment of the requirements
for the degree of Bachelor of Arts

Boston University
2026

Chapter 2. Methods

We interviewed four undergraduates about where they study at night. Participant 3, a 19-year-old sophomore majoring in ethnic studies from Iceland, lives in campus housing. Participant 5 is a senior majoring in economics who lives off campus. Participant 7, a 20-year-old sophomore majoring in biomedical engineering from Sweden, lives in campus housing. Participant 9, a 19-year-old first-year majoring in physics, lives in campus housing and is a varsity athlete.

Chapter 3. Findings

Most participants preferred quiet spaces after 10 PM. Participant 3 described the library basement as the only place that felt calm during exam weeks, while Participant 9 studied in team facilities between practices.
